about: What sessions did towards go-live, newest first. One line per thing that changed what the owner must do. Owner ticks are logged by the dashboard itself from the artifact database.

entries.what: Launch crash fixed: the release shrinker had removed a class Google's ads SDK needs (0.5.0+5 died before drawing). A smoke test now installs every release build on an emulator first. A specialist team (Play policy, release hardening, accessibility, design director, store graphics, privacy) reviewed the app; their fixes are in 0.5.2: start-up recovery screen, 133 accessibility checks, no days-to-go counter, help from the lock screen, change goal and due date in Settings, undo, in-app privacy policy link. Paste-ready Play form answers, store icon and feature graphic are ready. Four new asks for you.

Dashboard audit: every ticked step was checked against the repository, Vercel and the live site; steps that are done and checked now sit in a collapsed 'archived' block at the foot of their phase (the Done filter still shows them). Session steps done: store listing (support email filled, French and Spanish drafts), release candidate built, store screenshots rendered. Three new requests for you: install the release candidate, the missing NVDA notes, the Tag Manager re-import. Routines wait on your word (a recurring cost).

The pregnancy warning-signs sentence now names vaginal bleeding and a change in the baby's movements (your NHS pages), on the website's pregnancy calculator and in the app. The app's Help now screen also carries the sixteen countries. Website live (main 0442199); the app changes ship with the next build.

Help now now lists sixteen countries (Gulf, Jordan, Lebanon, Morocco, UK, France, Spain, USA, Canada, Mexico), every number read on an official page; Egypt's Facebook sources are gone. Algeria, Tunisia and Iraq have no official page we could find, so they are pointed to Find a Helpline. Live on femioapp.com since 2026-10-30 (main c5a3a17), together with the Tag Manager container fix and the flags in the language switcher.

Your 'File format is invalid' on the container import was a real defect in the file: event tags referenced the configuration tag the retired way and the consent block was mis-shaped. Fixed, guarded by the gate; download the file again before importing.

Your notes acted on: flags beside the language names in the switcher; the site no longer says 'Arabic-first' or names Saudi Arabia and Egypt (four languages, worldwide); iPhone reads 'Coming soon'; Learn cards show the whole art at one size; the three Arabic content decisions recorded as ADR-077; the two extra pregnancy red flags now have NHS sources (register MR-29) and are queued for the card.

Answers in the items: feedback form → Google Forms with the exact anonymous settings (item feedback-form); auto-indexing via the Indexing API → not allowed for ordinary pages, the sitemap is the channel (item url-inspection).
Deployed to femioapp.com: the language switcher, 'Dr. Khaled M., MD', the legal pages with KM Digital Labs, info@femioapp.com and the effective date. Verified live in English and Arabic.

Your phone-check notes acted on: a language switcher (header + footer, names in each language, no flags), the reviewer now reads 'Dr. Khaled M., MD' everywhere, the legal pages print KM Digital Labs, info@femioapp.com and the effective date. Branch protection: GitHub's Free plan does not enforce it on a private repo, so it is deferred. Two Vercel variables are yours to delete (request).

Deployed to femioapp.com: the privacy notice that names the app's ads (EN/AR/FR/ES) and /app-ads.txt (a comment until your pub- id is in Vercel). Verified live: policy still closed, no ad markup while the ids are unset.
ADR-076 accepted in chat: ads on the app too; her health data never leaves the phone, the ads SDK may.

App ads built: AdMob banners on the Learn list and open guides only, non-personalised, femio Plus removes them; privacy notice, Play answers, listing and the gate rewritten to say exactly what leaves the phone (the ad request) and what never does (her records).
Deployed to femioapp.com: AdSense code (off until ids), the Content-Security-Policy fix, /ads.txt. Verified live: policy closed and no ad markup while the ids are unset.
Go-live dashboard built from 69 steps in 9 phases; the earlier checklist's ticks carry over (same step ids).

AdSense built behind Vercel variables: two units per article, one per hub, filled only after the consent tool grants ad_storage; /ads.txt route; sensitive pages never carry a unit (checked by the gate).

Found and fixed: the live site's Content-Security-Policy would have blocked the Tag Manager loader the day the id was set. The policy now opens the Google, Meta and AdSense hosts only when their ids exist.

Play Billing spike: the billing library pulled in telemetry that asks for INTERNET; removed in the manifest, proved in the signed release build (permissions: BILLING, notifications, boot, vibrate). Phone check is yours.
ADR-076 proposed: ads inside the app are a separate decision with four costs; nothing is wired until you decide.
Deployed to femioapp.com: the rewritten privacy notice (EN/AR/FR/ES); consent and Tag Manager code present, inert until the id is set.
ADR-075 accepted: the website may measure visits and carry ads after consent; the app stays untouched.
Growth operations opened: plan, measurement design, monetization, owner guide A–J, routines R1–R7, Tag Manager container export ready to import.
Version 3 merged to main and live on femioapp.com.
